description: An interactive field guide to asteroid sample return: Hayabusa's crippled seven-year trip home from Itokawa, Hayabusa2's artificial crater on Ryugu, OSIRIS-REx sinking into Bennu's loose surface, ion engines and the rocket equation, gravity on a rubble pile where a pebble can be thrown into orbit, and the energy of a capsule hitting the air at 12 km/s.
og: Ion engines, rubble-pile gravity, an artificial crater and a 12 km/s re-entry — how three spacecraft brought asteroids home, interactive and sourced.
brand: SAMPLE — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
